# Xavier GUERET — DevOps Engineer

> Personal portfolio and technical blog. Bilingual site (French/English).
> URL: https://xgueret.github.io

---

## About Xavier GUERET

Xavier GUERET is a DevOps Engineer based in Guadeloupe, with 11 years of experience in software development. Originally a Java developer, he transitioned to DevOps through Linux environment management, application deployment on OpenShift and Kubernetes, and building reproducible infrastructure with Ansible and Terraform.

**Certifications:**
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (002)

**Core Skills:**
- Automation: Terraform, Ansible
- CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions
- Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
- Scripting: Bash, Python

**Social Profiles:**
- GitHub: https://github.com/xgueret
- GitLab: https://gitlab.com/xgueret
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/xgueret

## Blog Topics & Key Articles

### Infrastructure as Code & Homelab

**My Homelab: From Proxmox to Kubernetes, Fully Automated**
A comprehensive walkthrough of building an Infrastructure as Code monorepo to manage a personal homelab — Proxmox virtualization, Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters — all orchestrated with Terraform and Ansible. The project demonstrates enterprise-grade IaC practices applied to a home environment.

### AI & Developer Tools

**Build an AI Email Analysis Assistant with Claude Code**
Step-by-step tutorial on creating a complete email analysis pipeline using Claude Code, integrating with Gmail API, and building AI-powered email classification and summarization.

**Generate Excalidraw Diagrams from Claude Code with MCP**
Technical tutorial on using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect Claude Code with Excalidraw for automated diagram generation. Covers MCP server setup, Chromium headless rendering, and workflow automation.

**VS Code + Continue + Ollama for Local AI Development**
Guide to setting up a fully local AI coding assistant using VS Code with the Continue extension and Ollama for running LLMs locally. Zero cloud dependency, full privacy.

**Open WebUI with Llama 3**
Tutorial on deploying Open WebUI as a self-hosted ChatGPT alternative, powered by Llama 3 via Ollama.

### Kubernetes & Container Orchestration

**CKAD Dojo — Kubernetes Training Platform**
A training platform for CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer) exam preparation, featuring hands-on exercises and real-world scenarios.

**Deploy Portainer to Manage Docker**
Step-by-step guide to deploying Portainer for Docker container management with a web UI.

### DevOps Best Practices

**Pre-commit Hooks for Clean Code**
How to set up and configure pre-commit hooks to enforce code quality standards automatically before each commit.

**Bash Autocompletion for Ansible**
Setting up intelligent bash autocompletion for Ansible commands and playbooks.

### Developer Tools

**CV Converter — Multi-format Resume Generator**
A tool that converts a single resume source into multiple output formats (PDF, HTML, Markdown).

**ManageRepo — Git Repository Manager**
CLI tool for managing multiple Git repositories across different providers.

**PDFSeparate — PDF Splitting Tool**
Utility for splitting PDF documents by page ranges.

**LocalCompute — Distributed Local Compute**
Framework for distributing computational workloads across local machines.

## Site Structure

- **Homepage**: Overview with recent articles and trainings
- **Blog** (`/posts/`): Technical articles on DevOps, Kubernetes, AI, automation
- **Projects** (`/projects/`): Portfolio of GitHub projects, websites, and training materials
- **Training** (`/training/`): Available training courses
- **About** (`/about/`): Professional background and skills
- **CV** (`/cv/`): Detailed resume with certifications
- **Contact** (`/contact/`): Contact form
- **Categories** (`/categories/`): Articles organized by topic (DevOps, GitHub, AI, etc.)

All pages available in French (root) and English (`/en/` prefix).
